reason: I viewed all 66 chronological pages of each option before the director rationale. B is the stronger complete film. Its opening floor plan (0 to 2.4 s) shows footprints leaving the station as the door closes, a visible walkout where A shows only a static door and apron for its first beat. B's s4 plan push-in follows the paid token to the printer before the ticket and flare (24.6 to 27.8 s). Its s6 pass view (36.6 s) ties the coins back to the printer and ticket. The s7 pen loop exits the card instead of covering the text (44.4 to 44.8 s). The closing detail (58.4 to 60.47 s) holds the printer with its Chow mein ticket above the jar, with both tags large and legible. A's close puts the no record shown tag across the panel pole and nearly over the jar in a wide shot (58.4 to 59.8 s).
